entities.title: Cleaning log lines
entities.summary: With --log, the proxy writes one line per cleaned answer to its standard error: what it answered and the estimated tokens before and after.
entities.name: zazzle daemon proxy: tools/call NAME ~A→~B tokens (or resources/read)
entities.meaning: One server answer whose texts were shortened, with the estimated size before and after.
entities.access: Whoever holds the proxy's standard error; for a stdio proxy that is usually the MCP client's log.
excludes: The texts themselves, request arguments and answers that were not shortened are not logged.

entities.title: HTTP listen line
entities.summary: In HTTP mode the proxy writes `zazzle daemon proxy: http://ADDR → URL` to standard error once it listens.
entities.name: zazzle daemon proxy: http://ADDR → URL
entities.meaning: The proxy is listening on ADDR (with the port the system chose, if 0 was asked) and forwards to URL.
entities.access: Whoever holds the proxy's standard error.

entities.title: Request traces
entities.summary: While tracing is on, each request a proxy serves gets a folder with the request, the response before and after cleaning, and a results file.
entities.name: DIR/MMDD_HHmmss/{1-request,2-response-raw,3-response,4-results}.json
entities.meaning: One agent request and its answer, as the server sent it and as the agent got it, with what cleaning saved and how long each side took.
entities.unit: Estimated tokens, bytes, lines and milliseconds.
dimensions: tokens raw, returned, saved and saved percent
filter settings and whether it changed the answer
entities.access: The user who switched tracing on, in the folder they named.
entities.retention: Kept until the user deletes the folders.
entities.cadence: Per answered request while `zazzle trace on` holds; switched by ~/.zazzle/trace.json, read on every request.
excludes: Notifications, server-to-client requests and requests never answered are not traced.
